verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own conversational search generates AI answers grounded in indexed content, so asking questions of your data is product-native. Nothing shows AI-generated insights or proactive suggestions about the data or search configuration: analytics only tracks queries, clicks and conversions, and the MCP natural-language workflow runs in an external AI client, not inside the product. missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analysis over the data, in-product AI suggestions (e.g. relevancy or configuration recommendations), detailed docs on the conversational feature, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Let users ask questions and get real answers, grounded in your own content.
exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API
